prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1208; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and back pain. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the clinical picture seen on examination, and the complaints are plausible for a crash of this kind. Over the course of 22 visits, the patient received a standard conservative regimen including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instructions. Care followed a typical progression and tapered as symptoms improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. The patient's history shows treatment to the same body area within the past two years, and this prior condition contributes to some of the current symptoms and should be considered when assessing present function. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for the services rendered. Patient is expected to continue home exercise and return as needed.
